correctness.rationale: For fixed h,P,v and homogeneous epidemiology, set s=P^T h, r=v/s, q=P r, M=sum hq^2. For Perron eigenvector y of K_D=(mu I-D)^(-1)L set z=y/v. Balanced stationary flows F_ij=d_ij v_j and x-1>=log x give E=sum_i(Dy)_i/z_i>=0, strict unless y proportional to v. Groupwise Cauchy–Schwarz gives sum_i(Ly)_i/z_i>=sum_k h_kq_k^2=M, hence mu rho(K_D)>=M. If equality, E=0 and Lv=Mv; weighted inner product forces all q_k=M=1. Conversely q all=1 gives column sums of K_D=1/mu. Fast complete-generator D_k=k(v1^T-I) proves sharp infimum M by rank-one resolvent limit. Independent rational stationary-distribution and spectral example checks succeeded, including heterogeneous exposure strictness; no finite bound extrapolation.
